prompting.structure: 精准主体 + 动作细节 + 场景环境 + 光影色调 + 镜头运镜 + 视觉风格 + 画质 + 约束条件
prompting.language: 中文、英文；台词语言统一，不要中英混用；不要整段贴剧本
prompting.length: 中文 500 字以内，英文 1000 词以内
prompting.multi_shot: 用「镜头 1 / 镜头 2 / 镜头 3」，每个镜头写运镜、动作、地点、声音。不要给镜头写秒数：官方说对精确时间的支持不稳定，硬限时长可能出异常。对话戏适合一镜到底，快动作拆成几段再拼
prompting.references: 先定义再复用：「将图片1中的…定义为主体1」，或简写「张三@图片1」，每个主体带 2–3 个稳定特征；最重要的参考放最前面。模板：「参考图片N中的主体N，生成…」「参考视频N中的动作 / 运镜 / 风格 / 音效，生成…」「参考音频N中的音色，生成…」。即梦全能参考可以写「@图片1 作为首帧，@视频1 参考镜头语言，@音频1 用于配乐」。建议 1–2 张人物图、1 张场景图、1 段运镜视频、1 段音频，不要塞满
prompting.dialogue: 四种符号：音乐（背景中播放着…），音效 <远处传来狗叫声>，台词 {你好，世界}，字幕【第一章：启程】。其他语言写「用日语说道{…}」。指定音色写「使用@音频1…的音色说」，音色会有偏差
prompting.negatives: 没有负面提示词字段，约束写在末尾：「保持无字幕」「避免生成任何文字或字幕」「不要生成Logo」「不要生成水印」。官方承认做不到完全不出字幕，横屏比竖屏出得少
prompting.camera: 直接用标准运镜术语（中景、特写、全景、缓慢推镜、平稳横移、固定镜头）；一个镜头只指定一种运镜
prompting.frame_mode: 要严格保住首尾帧就用首尾帧模式（role=first_frame / last_frame），不能和参考素材同传；写「首帧为图片1」是宽松的替代。编辑或延长视频时直接写「视频N」，不要写「参考视频N」，否则会被当成参考任务
prompting.frames: 人物参考用大头照加全身照，不建议多视图；脸在图里太小会掉脸
pitfalls: 容易出分身 / 双胞胎，末尾加一句全局禁止
多音字、生僻字、形近字会读错
写实参考图会把风格化画面拉回实拍
参考超过 4 个人时稳定性下降
反复续写后人脸会劣化

review_story.summary: A two-hander farce: a host ruins lunch for his boss and covers it with a chain of ever less plausible lies, each of which the boss challenges and then accepts.
review_story.hook: The first line at 3.7 s is an insult from the guest ('I made it, despite your directions'), so the power gap is clear before anything goes wrong; the oven is smoking by 13 s and the plan is spoken alo
highlights: 21-30 s: the character tells the audience his plan in a push-in close-up, so every later lie plays as dramatic irony
34-49 s: a full mock sitcom title sequence with a sung jingle interrupts the scene at the moment of highest tension (he is caught climbing out of the window)
71-116 s: strict question / answer rhythm in alternating close-ups, shots as short as 0.7 s ('Yes.'), each answer inventing a fact the next question attacks
136-151 s: five punch-in cuts on one angle for the 'Aurora Borealis' tirade, then three near-silent one-line shots ('Yes.' / 'May I see it?' / 'No.') that drop the energy to nothing

camera.setups: Animation, no physical camera. About 14 recurring layouts over 4 painted locations (house exterior and porch, dining room, kitchen, title-sequence wall); most shots are locked off, with a push-in in #11, a long pan in #15 and a pull-back in #53.
camera.gear_guess: Not applicable: traditional 2D animation, drawn at film rate (the file is 23.976 fps). The 16:9 1080p frame is a crop and upscale of a 4:3 standard-definition broadcast original.

lighting.lighting_overall: No lighting rig: flat painted colour. Fire is the only light effect, drawn as an orange-pink glow (oven interior #9, door edge #40/#48/#50, windows #53/#56).

grade.grade_overall: Saturated flat palette: purple-blue walls, yellow skin, navy and light-blue suits; kitchen is desaturated teal with grey smoke. No grade beyond the upscale's smoothing.

editing.editing: 56 shots in 169 s (3.0 s average), all hard cuts. Dialogue is cut as shot / reverse shot between two fixed close-ups; the tirade at 136-147 s uses five cuts on the same angle, tighter each time, one per phrase. No beat sync.
